question: Should OpenClaw adopt the shared `@openclaw/fs-safe` 0.4.7 durability contract across these strict and formerly best-effort publication paths after the dependency and real-runtime evidence are refreshed?
rationale: This is an intentional cross-cutting persistence-behavior change with a protected maintainer label; source review alone cannot choose the repository’s acceptable unsupported-filesystem and operational-failure policy.

options.title: Validate and land the shared boundary
options.body: Refresh the branch, verify the dependency delta and strict-versus-compatible caller behavior, and land once real publication evidence and required checks match the merged head.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Keep only the snapshot and TLS paths needed for the linked durability report, leaving other call sites on their established behavior until separately validated.

recommendation.title: Validate and land the shared boundary
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, verify the dependency delta and strict-versus-compatible caller behavior, and land once real publication evidence and required checks match the merged head.
